title: CobbleSwipes
description: A Cobblemon data pack that adds more variety to false swipe options.
body:
This is a Cobblemon data pack that adds more variety to false swipe options. This may be a completely unnecessary addition, but I saw that no one else has done it. I decided to create this for those who are curious.

To install:

Singleplayer
- Download the .zip
- Drop into your resourcepacks folder
- Drop into your saves/World Name/datapacks folder
- Reload or restart your world
- Activate the resource pack

Server
- Place the data pack in your server world folder
- Restart the server
